title: Blue Mountain "30A All Day" Beach 2046 W County Highway 30A M2420
h1: Blue Mountain "30A All Day" Beach 2046 W County Highway 30A M2420
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Views of the Gulf- 6-minute walk to the beach, only .2 miles from the Condo- Private Beach access with bathrooms for Redfish Village guests- Community lounge with gym, library, and TV room- Large heated pool with separate hot tub- Green Space for activities- Boardwalk to fish and enjoy water views- 4 adult bikes- Steps away from Redfish Taco, Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, & many more restaurants!- Complete Clean Linen Participant—ALL linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: As the name implies, 30A All Day is a spacious 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom Condo that sleeps ten along the famous Scenic 30A In the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, enjoy access to the community pool, children's playground, and an elevated boardwalk that connects the pool deck to Redfish Lake and the overlook area Guests will love the incredible Gulf views from this top-floor condominium!With 1,600 square feet of living space, this sizeable condominium is perfect for entertaining friends and family. The open floor plan is bright and airy, with natural light flooding in from the large picture windows that frame the emerald waters below. A cozy yet roomy living area offers comfortable seating with a linen Couch, a loveseat, and one armchair in front of the TV . The natural wood cabinets, stainless appliances, and a large island/ breakfast bar seat five and make it easy to cook up an old family recipe. At the same time, the 6-person dining table provides ample space for eating and reconnecting. A large furnished balcony, accessible from the great room and primary bedroom, delivers breathtaking sunrise and sunset views of the Gulf. Down the hallway, a full-sized washer and dryer are available for use, as well as the four tranquil bedrooms—1 spacious primary bedroom, two guest bedrooms, and one bunk area with two twin-over-twin beds.Get ready to host memorable gatherings in this inviting space at 30A All Day! With assigned parking in a gated garage and four complimentary adult bikes, it's easy to explore the local area. To enjoy Redfish Village's private beach access (0.2 mi), head right on 30A until the first stop sign at Old Blue Mountain Roa. Turn left, follow this to Blue Mountain Road, then turn right. The private beach access will be visible on the left! Book this incredible location today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedsGuests will love the heated pool, boardwalk on the lake, private beach access, playground, fitness center, and outdoor kitchen for grilling. Chair and umbrella sets are also available for rental.PLEASE NOTE:- No pets are allowed at this vacation rental.- Parking notes: The Condo has one assigned parking space in the covered parking area. Additional vehicles may park in the open parking lot areas.
